banner.title: esphome
banner.tagline: Builds and flashes ESPHome firmware for the IoT VLAN, with a code-server editor on the same config.

explainer.title: Dashboard on the IoT VLAN, config on Ceph

steps.title: Secrets
steps.text: ExternalSecret esphome-secrets renders secrets.yaml from items esphome and emqx: Wi-Fi, the MQTT login and the domain. The Git deploy key comes from item esphome.
steps.scene: a vault door opening onto a small key

steps.title: Address
steps.text: Multus adds net1 on multus-iot with a fixed 10.40.0.131 address, so the dashboard reaches devices on the IoT VLAN directly.
steps.scene: two network switches linked by a glowing cable

steps.title: Compile
steps.text: The esphome container compiles and flashes firmware from /config. Build cache is an emptyDir, and the 3 GiB limit leaves room for the compiler.
steps.scene: a microchip assembled from glowing blocks

steps.title: Edit
steps.text: code-server serves /config at /code/ on envoy-internal, with the deploy key mounted for git over SSH.
steps.scene: a code window floating above a circuit board

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: The kopiur component snapshots the esphome-config claim to R2 once a day.
steps.scene: snapshot cards sliding into a cloud bucket
